Description: Verify a user with a Salesforce Integration license can perform a complete Copado CI/CD cycle in a Sandbox environment.
Pre-conditions: Admin access to a Salesforce Sandbox; At least one 'Salesforce Integration' license is available; A sample User Story with metadata components is ready for deployment.
Step Description: Create a new user and assign the 'Salesforce Integration' license.
Expected Result: The user is created successfully without errors.

Step Description: Assign all necessary Copado-related permission sets to the new user.
Expected Result: All required permission sets are assigned without any license-related restrictions or errors.

Step Description: Grant the user's profile/permission set access to the Copado Connected App.
Expected Result: The user is authorized to access the Copado application via API.

Step Description: Using the new user's credentials/context, perform a 'Commit' on the sample User Story.
Expected Result: The commit operation completes successfully and the changes are registered in the source control repository.

Step Description: 'Promote' the committed User Story to the next environment in the pipeline.
Expected Result: The promotion process completes successfully.

Step Description: 'Deploy' the promoted User Story to the target environment.
Expected Result: The deployment completes successfully with all components deployed as expected.

Step Description: Execute a 'Back Promotion' for the same User Story.
Expected Result: The back promotion process completes without errors.

Test Case Name: Production License Switch and Smoke Test
Description: Validate the process of switching the license in Production and perform a high-level smoke test to ensure no immediate disruption.
Pre-conditions: All Sandbox tests (E2E-01) have passed; A maintenance window is scheduled; Production admin access is available; A rollback plan is in place.
Step Description: In Production navigate to the existing Copado API User's record.
Expected Result: The user record is accessible.

Step Description: Change the User License from 'Salesforce' to 'Salesforce Integration' and save.
Expected Result: The license is switched successfully. The user remains active.

Step Description: Re-assign any necessary permission sets if they were removed during the license change.
Expected Result: All required permission sets are correctly assigned.

Step Description: Monitor the Copado CI/CD jobs for the next hour.
Expected Result: All scheduled and triggered CI jobs continue to run without authentication or permission errors.

Step Description: Manually trigger a small low-risk validation deployment in Production.
Expected Result: The validation deployment completes successfully confirming the user's ability to perform basic operations.

Description: Determine the system's behavior if the Salesforce Integration license does not provide sufficient permissions for a critical Copado operation.
Pre-conditions: During Sandbox testing (E2E-01), a specific operation (e.g., deployment) is expected to fail due to license limitations.
Step Description: Attempt to execute a Copado deployment that involves a metadata type potentially restricted by the Integration license.
Expected Result: The deployment process initiates.

Step Description: Observe the deployment results and logs within Copado.
Expected Result: The deployment fails.

Step Description: Analyze the error message provided by Copado/Salesforce.
Expected Result: The error message clearly indicates that the failure is due to insufficient permissions or a license limitation (e.g., 'API access denied for object X').

Description: Verify that the integration documentation is created or updated to be complete, audit-ready, and compliant with organizational standards.
Pre-conditions: The integration documentation has been written or updated and is available at a specified Confluence URL.
Step Description: Access the provided Confluence link for the Salesforce–Jira–Copado integration documentation.
Expected Result: The page is accessible and loads correctly.

Step Description: Compare the document's structure (headings, tables, layout) against the reference template ([Account Team Management Documentation](https://confluence.constellation.soprasteria.com/spaces/SFSUPPORTDE/pages/1260877213/Account+Team+Management+Account+Hierarchy+Inheritance+Functionality)).
Expected Result: The structure is consistent with the established organizational standard.

Step Description: Review the content to ensure it covers the end-to-end integration, including user setup, permission sets, connected app details, and the CI/CD workflow between Salesforce, Jira, and Copado.
Expected Result: The documentation is comprehensive accurate and covers all required components of the integration.

Step Description: Check for a troubleshooting or error-handling section.
Expected Result: A section exists that provides guidance on common issues and their resolutions.

Test Case Name: Fallback Plan - New Production User Creation
Description: Test the contingency plan of creating a new dedicated Integration User in Production if the existing user cannot be migrated.
Pre-conditions: A decision has been made that the existing Production user cannot be switched (e.g., due to credential issues); Production admin access is available.
Step Description: In Production create a new user with the 'Salesforce Integration' license.
Expected Result: The new user is created successfully.

Step Description: Assign all required Copado permission sets and configure Connected App access for the new user.
Expected Result: All configurations are applied successfully.

Step Description: Update all relevant Copado configurations (e.g. Git Snapshot CI Jobs) to use the new Integration User's credentials.
Expected Result: The configuration is updated to point to the new user.

Step Description: Execute a test deployment using the new user's context.
Expected Result: The deployment completes successfully validating that the new user is fully functional.
